subtitle: Parts that keep the platform serviceable
description: An identifiable caliper service set: backing plates, lining blocks, retainer pins and bushes. It is scoped to AI Braking concepts; no fit or compatibility with a competitor brake is implied.
targets: Process objective, not achieved factory evidence
decisions: Separate wear parts from structural parts in the BOM and drawing numbering.
Source the friction compound and its retention process from a specialist.
Mark non-friction backing surfaces, avoiding stress-sensitive and rubbing surfaces.
materials: Backing plate: C45 candidate, corrosion protection excluded from bond/friction areas.
Lining: supplier-controlled non-asbestos compound, not a generic material grade.
Pins/bushes: certified steel and purchased bronze candidates.
risks: Friction coefficient changes with pressure, speed, temperature and wear.
Bond strength, rivet design, retainer fatigue and wear limits are not specified.
steps: Verify parent brake revision and compound lot.
Inspect backing plate and clean bond surfaces using supplier process.
Bond/retain lining only to an approved supplier procedure.
Install pins and bushes with the engineer-approved fit and retention.
validation: Bond/retention strength, dimensional fit and compound lot consistency.
Paired dynamometer testing of fade, recovery and wear.
hypotheses: Test scanning and human-readable part identification in service trials.
Confirm common parts without extending compatibility beyond released drawings.
sensors: Record digital part/lot identity and wear measurement requirements; sensor design deferred.
